title: State School Fund by two-year budget, billions of dollars, not adjusted for inflation
description: Bar chart of Oregon's State School Fund by two-year budget: adopted for 2023-25 and 2025-27, and the 2027-29 current service level estimate.
notes: 2027-29 is the Department of Administrative Services' current service level estimate, as used in the Quality Education Commission's 2026 report, not an adopted budget [SRC:ode/qec/2026_qem_report.pdf p.103].
